$comment: ADR-037 register fragment (events-async-api-products). Deep-merges `channels` onto api_product, so a product carries event channels next to its endpoints and one product subscription covers both (design.md D1), and `productSubscription`/`productChannel` onto event_subscription, so a consumer's channel push subscription names the product subscription it rides on (REQ-AAPI-003). See openspec/changes/events-async-api-products/design.md and specs/api-product-gateway/spec.md#requirement-an-api-product-can-declare-event-channels-req-aapi-001.

channels.title: Channels
channels.description: Event channels this product version carries next to its endpoints. A consumer with an active subscription to the product reaches a channel under the same key, tier rate limit and quota as the product's endpoints. Each channel's slug is unique within the product version.

slug.description: The channel's id in the product's routes and AsyncAPI document, e.g. 'publications'
slug.title: Slug

types.description: The CloudEvent types the channel carries, e.g. 'nl.woo.publication.created'
types.title: CloudEvent types

description.description: What the channel carries, for the AsyncAPI document and the product page
description.title: Description

productSubscription.description: The api_product_subscription uuid a consumer's channel subscription rides on. Set only on subscriptions created through a product channel; a push delivery checks it is still active before sending (REQ-AAPI-003).
productSubscription.title: Product subscription

productChannel.description: The slug of the product channel this subscription was created through.
productChannel.title: Product channel
